question: Where is the subtle flame absorbed within the contemplative locus addressed to the beautiful-faced one?
premises: A flame is present in that location
The absorption occurs in the bone wheel
inference: There, O beautiful-faced one, the flame is absorbed in the wheel of bone.
uncertainties: asthi cakre interpreted as bone-wheel location
plain_english: There indeed, O beautiful-faced one, the flame is absorbed in the wheel of bone.
